status: frozen before baseline and candidate measurement
objective: Reduce inference complete-answer latency by at least 10 percent per accepted step. Stop at the first measured candidate that does not meet the acceptance gates.
prompt: Describe what you see in this image in one sentence.
transport: serial streaming requests through Orin-local UI proxy, no camera capture interval in the isolated inference benchmark
primary_metric: geometric mean of per-fixture median complete-answer latency; equal image weighting, compared with last accepted candidate
acceptance: at least 10 percent reduction of the primary metric
no per-fixture p95 or median latency regression greater than 5 percent
byte-identical output text, completion token count and normal stop reason for every measured request, relative to repeatable baseline; otherwise investigate and do not accept as equivalent
no errors, OOM, swap I/O or queue backlog; at least 512 MiB available shared RAM
same images, prompt, token ceiling, sampling, power mode, dynamic clock policy and engine shapes
publish TTFT, completion tokens, all per-fixture latency summaries, system shared RAM and process RSS separately
tie_or_noise_policy: Repeat matched baseline/candidate once only when the 10 percent threshold or equivalence is ambiguous. A confirmed failure ends this search and restores the last accepted candidate.
candidate_hypothesis: Reduce redundant work in the native top-K sampler while preserving partition, comparator, arithmetic, output and RNG semantics; profile first. Other candidates are considered only after an accepted improvement.
limits: screen-recording-derived camera crops, not raw original camera inputs
three examples are a controlled workload, not a representative accuracy benchmark
baseline mistakes remain mistakes even when byte-identical
historical 512x512, 64-token, greedy results are not a comparison denominator
timings exclude browser capture/encoding and Wi-Fi, but include image decode, inference and local proxy streaming
